chunks: And al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
When a man performs wudu (ablution), let him splash his face with water, for if he is drowsy, he will be stirred and awaken; and if there is cold, he will be stirred and not feel the cold.
ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teach about splashing the face with water during wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs that during wudu (ablution), one should splash water on the face. It highlights a practical benefit of this act: it removes drowsiness and helps one bear the cold, supporting attentiveness and ease in worship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.106 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"
'When a man performs ablution, let him splash his face with water, for if he is drowsy, it will awaken him, and if it is cold, he will not feel the cold.'".
